description: This file provides type declarations for the 'node:timers/promises' module, describing functions like setTimeout, setImmediate, setInterval, and an API for scheduling, for use in TypeScript projects.

methods.name: function setTimeout<T = void>(delay?: number, value?: T, options?: TimerOptions): Promise<T>/ setTimeout
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a delay with an optional value, configured via parameters.

methods.name: setImmediate
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves immediately with a given value.

methods.name: setInterval
methods.description: Returns an async iterator that yields values at specified intervals.

methods.name: scheduler.wait
methods.description: An experimental method that returns a promise resolving after a specified delay.

methods.name: scheduler.yield
methods.description: An experimental method that yields control back to the event loop.

ctags.name: setTimeout
ctags.pattern: /^    function setTimeout<T = void>(delay?: number, value?: T, options?: TimerOptions): Promise<T>/
